Subject: Updated Workshop Schedule

Dear Participants,

Thank you for registering for our upcoming workshop. We are writing to let you know about a change to the schedule: the practical session has been moved to the afternoon.

Registration will still begin at 8:45 a.m., so please arrive on time to check in and collect your materials. The morning will now focus on the introductory presentations, followed by lunch, which is included for all participants. The practical session will begin shortly afterward.

Please remember to bring your laptop, as you will need it for the hands-on activities.

We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your flexibility. If you have questions, please reply to this email.

Kind regards,

Emily Carter
Workshop Coordinator
task: Write a professional email explaining a fictional workshop schedule change: the practical session moves to the afternoon, registration remains at 8:45, lunch is included, and participants should bring laptops.
